tenders.title: Tender For Expression Of Interest (Eoi) For Enlistment Of Contractors For Laser Scanning And 3D Modelling Works
tenders.scope_summary: Expression of Interest (EOI) for enlistment of contractors for laser scanning and 3D modelling works. The scope of work includes undertaking laser scanning and subsequent 3D modeling for various urban development projects.
key_points: Enlistment of contractors for future projects.
Involves laser scanning and 3D modeling.
Targeted towards urban and rural development initiatives.

tenders.title: Supply, Installation and Commissioning of Non Contact Laser Scanning Based Wheel Profile Measurement System
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for the supply, installation, and commissioning of a non-contact laser scanning-based wheel profile measurement system. The system should adhere to the attached specifications provided by the tendering authority.
key_points: Supply, installation, and commissioning of non-contact laser scanning system.
Specifically for wheel profile measurement.
Must comply with attached specifications.

tenders.title: Custom Bid For Services - 3D Scanning Modelling Drawing
tenders.scope_summary: Bids are invited for custom services related to 3D scanning, modeling, and drawing. This likely pertains to asset documentation and design in the petroleum and natural gas sector.
key_points: Custom bid for 3D scanning services.
Includes 3D modeling and drawing deliverables.
Relevant for the Petroleum and Natural Gas industry.

tenders.title: Scanning And Digitisation Service (Version 2) - 200; A4 And Legal
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for scanning and digitization services, specifically for A4 and legal-sized documents. The service is listed as 'version 2' and involves digitizing a volume of 200 units.
key_points: Scanning and digitization of documents.
Covers A4 and legal paper sizes.
Volume of 200 units.

tenders.title: Custom Bid For Services - Cost Of Skilled Manpower For Locomotive Maintenance Record Keeping, Data Entry, Data Feeding, Documentation And Mis Activities Including Statutory Bonus And Minimum Floor Price With Gst, Custom Bid For Services - Cost Of Computer And Printer For Locomotive Maintenance Record Keeping, Data Entry, Data Feeding, Documentation And Mis Activities With Gst
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks skilled manpower and equipment (computer and printer) for locomotive maintenance record keeping, data entry, data feeding, documentation, and MIS activities, including statutory bonus and minimum floor price with GST. The focus is on digital management of maintenance records.
key_points: Provision of skilled manpower for data entry and record keeping.
Supply of computers and printers for maintenance documentation.
Services for locomotive maintenance data management and MIS activities.

tenders.title: Custom Bid for Services - AMC services for Make-BioRAD D10 HPLC
tenders.scope_summary: This tender is for Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services for a Bio-Rad D10 HPLC system. The services are crucial for ensuring the continued performance and reliability of the laboratory equipment.
key_points: Annual Maintenance Contract for Bio-Rad D10 HPLC.
Ensures operational performance of scientific equipment.
Issued by a research institute (ICMR-NIRTH).

tenders.title: Customized AMC/CMC for Pre-owned Products - AMC Services for Genetic Analyzer; Invitrogen; Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC); Six-Monthly
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks customized Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) or Comprehensive Maintenance Contract (CMC) services for pre-owned Invitrogen Genetic Analyzers. The services are required on a six-monthly basis to maintain the equipment.
key_points: Customized AMC/CMC for pre-owned Invitrogen Genetic Analyzer.
Maintenance services required six-monthly.
Ensures functionality and longevity of specialized laboratory equipment.

tenders.title: Carry out preparation and submission of marking arrangement drawing using Tekla or equivalent 3D modeling software including submission of design calculation showing master index of particular structures including nomenclature to facilitate sequence of erection activity for all type of structures etc. by providing of all materials, equipment, machineries & manpower in connection with composite works for AVU Units (Part A) for Panipat Refinery Expansion Project (P-25) of M/s. IOCL
tenders.scope_summary: This tender involves the preparation and submission of marking arrangement drawings using Tekla or equivalent 3D modeling software, including design calculations and a master index for structures. The work supports the erection sequence for AVU units as part of the Panipat Refinery Expansion Project (P-25) for IOCL, requiring provision of all necessary materials, equipment, machinery, and manpower.
key_points: Preparation of marking arrangement drawings using 3D modeling software (Tekla or equivalent).
Submission of design calculations and master index for structures.
Facilitate erection sequence for AVU units.
Includes provision of all materials, equipment, machinery, and manpower.
Part of the Panipat Refinery Expansion Project (P-25) for IOCL.
